explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows Hospira, Inc. discontinued manufacture of diltiazem hydrochloride injection on 2026-01-05; the shortage has been posted for 104 months as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list records that Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, discontinued manufacture of diltiazem hydrochloride injection with an initial posting date of 2026-01-05.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 104 months.
The product label for NDC 00409435003 names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 976095 at that plant ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 623 days before the 2018-02-21 shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2017-02-14, 372 days before the 2018-02-21 posting.
FDA inspection 1064827 at the plant ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, 175 days after the 2018-02-21 posting.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-c782a4.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%diltiazem%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%diltiazem%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-31a419.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('bba03666-ff4f-4bf6-fa92-78e1ec2d9073', '11b43a17-8038-462b-8902-259431ad5256', '453b73bd-c52d-4d72-a0b3-47588e723e0b') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-47ea54.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%diltiazem%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-7510dc.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%diltiazem%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-abe349.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%diltiazem%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-82ef9a.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3000209995', '1925262', '3008461619') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-87593f.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3000209995', '1925262', '3008461619') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-330e45.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3000209995', '1925262') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('american health packaging', 'hikma berkeley heights', 'hospira')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-765ea5.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('american health packaging', 'hikma berkeley heights', 'hospira', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%diltiazem%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-086820.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('976095', '1064827') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-921798.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409435003', '60687021701', '00641601310')
